snow_note: Not analysed for snow (pre-dates pass-share disclosure). Base year.

LOW SNOW: 'historically low snowfall (cumulative snowfall down more than 50%)'; visits -12.1% (Colorado -8.9%, Tahoe -22.3%); non-pass visits -15.0%; pass revenue +13.2%; lift revenue flat. Kirkwood (Apr 2012) minor. Pass share 40%.
Recovery: CO poor snow until Christmas then strong (CO visits +4.0%); Tahoe +32.1% incl. Kirkwood, dry second half. Canyons (May 2013), urban ski areas acquired. Pass share 38%.
LOW SNOW in Tahoe only: 'very poor conditions in the Tahoe region', Tahoe visits -16.2%; Colorado visits +8.4%. Canyons first full year. Pass share 40%.
LOW SNOW in Tahoe again: 'unseasonably warm temperatures and very low snowfall', Tahoe visits -16.4%; Colorado strong. Park City (Sep 2014) and Perisher (Jun 2015) acquired. Pass share 40%.
Normal/rebound: 'strong rebound at our Tahoe resorts' on improved snowfall. Full year of Perisher; Wilmot (Jan 2016). Pass share 40%.
Poor early-season conditions before the holidays (Colorado); Whistler Blackcomb acquired Oct 2016 (ex-WB lift +6.4%); Stowe Jun 2017. Pass share 43%.

LOW SNOW in western US: 'historically low snowfall for the first half'; Vail/Beaver Creek/Park City snowfall lowest in 30+ years through Jan; Tahoe >50% below 20-yr avg. Same-store N. America season-to-date (to Mar 4) visits -4.9%, lift +1.6%. Whistler record year. Pass share 47%.
Improved western conditions. Stevens Pass, Triple Peaks (Okemo/Crested Butte/Sunapee), Falls Creek/Hotham acquired. Pass share 47%.
COVID-19: resorts closed mid-March 2020; $120.9M pass revenue deferred to FY2021. Peak Resorts (17 ski areas) acquired Sep 2019. Pass share 51%. Not usable for snow analysis.

COVID capacity limits plus 'snowfall levels that were well below average at our Colorado, Utah and Tahoe resorts through the holiday season'; Whistler closed early. Includes deferred FY2020 pass revenue. Pass share 61%. Not usable for snow analysis.
'Challenging early season conditions' delayed openings; COVID recovery; Epic Pass price cut 20%. Seven Springs (Dec 2021) acquired. Pass share 61%.
Record visitation; very big snow year in Utah/Tahoe; record Australian snow. Andermatt-Sedrun (Aug 2022). Pass share 61%.

Improved early-season West and East conditions; Australia poor. Pass units for 2024/25 -3% after the bad 2023/24 season. Pass share 65%.
